caption: The drawing is a grayscale pencil illustration depicting a single sheep standing on a horizontal bar, with another vertical bar extending downward from the center of the horizontal bar. The sheep is shown in profile, facing left, with its eyes closed or nearly closed. The body of the sheep is large and slightly textured, giving a sense of woolly fur, and the legs are straight and sturdy. The background is plain and uncolored, and the drawing is set within a thin, rectangular border. The artist's signature, "H. BADER," appears in the lower left corner of the image. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and black on a light, off-white background.
title: Weather Vane
